title: Enums and Pattern Matching
summary: Types that are one of several variants, each with its own data; Option instead of null; and match, if let and let...else to take values apart safely.
goals: Define enums whose variants carry different data, and give them methods
Use Option<T> to represent a value that may be missing, and explain why Rust has no null
Write exhaustive match expressions with bindings, guards, catch-alls and _
Choose between match, if let and let...else
